edits.new: A and B name topics used to organize social media posts. Does B fall entirely within A's subject matter? Answer yes if discussing B is necessarily discussing A, including when both titles name the same topic. Mere association or partial overlap is not enough: if B can be discussed without discussing A itself, answer no. If you cannot determine this from the meanings of the titles, answer uncertain.
edits.old: A and B name topics used to organize social media posts. Would every post about B also be about A? If you cannot determine this from the meanings of the titles, answer uncertain.
